fin_shortage.news: A fin shortage: the ring series bought every grippy fin on the dock. Fin prices are up, and sellers are smiling.

engine_glut.news: A freighter unloaded a hold full of drives. Engines are cheap this week.

cockpit_fad.news: Picture windows are in fashion. Everyone wants a new cockpit, and the prices show it.

lights_sale.news: The lamp-makers' guild is clearing stock. Lights are going cheap.

gadget_craze.news: Race gadgets are the talk of the dock. Prices for them have gone silly.
